A '''base''' of the [[Blood Razors]] was located in the [[Westerly]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the base was commanded by the Blood Razor [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jorund Saleem]].<ref name="SWG:MPwN" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] under orders of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] attacked to retrieve crates of munitions stolen from the [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].<ref name="SWG:MPwN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blood Razor base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MPwN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:MPwN" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
